question: On the frozen rule-v8 one-target Koblitz pipelines at n=53 and n=61, does the complete versioned aimed-LP adapter composition, after a focused gate proves parity of ordinary aimed three-sum opportunities, use exact double-large-prime elimination to reduce complete cold cost without changing targets, descent, verification, or accounting boundaries?

claims.text: Every admitted candidate row recovers and independently verifies the planted public logarithm, every projected relation passes both exact row replays, and replay-all reproduces every result and counter.

On the frozen c8a.2xlarge L2 host class, at least one preregistered versioned aimed-LP adapter composition lowers complete cold one-target wall time by at least 5% against the frozen aimed pipeline at both n=53 and n=61. Ordinary aimed three-sum opportunity parity is a mandatory focused gate, but the measured treatment remains the complete adapter composition. The 0/0.1/1 counted-cost band is descriptive and may be UNRANKABLE PRICING without changing the finite-host wall verdict.
claims.if_supported: Classify the winning configuration as a finite-host engineering improvement of the one-target aimed pipeline, separately at each size; do not extrapolate past this host class or n=61.
claims.if_not_supported: Report NULL, WORSE, or CENSORED NON-IMPROVEMENT for the wall claim and separately report the pricing-band status; preserve every failed, exhausted, capped, or timed-out row.

claims.text: The candidate's complete cold distance to the current matched signed-Frobenius rho is reported descriptively at both sizes. No rho win is claimed unless a future complete-pricing protocol supports it; this protocol's finite-host wall verdict concerns candidate versus aimed only.
claims.if_supported: Report the per-size candidate/rho ratios and the exact qualifying arm.
claims.if_not_supported: Report the measured distance as a lower-bound or unrankable comparison, never as a rho win.

claims.text: Deployed-key recovery, asymptotic improvement, curves above n=61, Table C/32-target batching, amortized precomputation, and a claim that predecessor PR #2850 measured the aimed pipeline are outside scope. Table C would require its own versioned shared-state method and protocol; repeated one-target calls are not a batch measurement.

hypotheses.statement: Closing exact 2LP partials inside the aimed rule-v8 relation stream reduces enough collection work to repay its additional cold domain, table, verification, and elimination cost.
hypotheses.mechanism: The adapter first completes the exact frozen PairSumTable scan over the exact aimed window. Only an ordinary miss enters a separately counted partials-only LP pass or mutates its graph. After a deterministic focused gate proves that this preserves the frozen collector's ordinary aimed three-sum trial census and probe scalars, the disjoint domain turns those failed aimed three-sum probes into exact partial rows; graph closure supplies sparse projected rows while keeping the same factor-base columns and descent. The causal treatment is the full versioned adapter composition, including the incremental second scan on ordinary misses, not graph closure in isolation.

power.note: The independent units are eight public targets per size; five rounds are repeated timings within each target, not n=40. The exact one-sided sign-flip test has 2^8=256 assignments (minimum one-sided p=1/256; minimum two-sided p=2/256), so the first Holm boundary 0.0125 is attainable. Normal-approximation sensitivity at 80% power and the first Holm boundary requires target-level paired ratio SD about <=0.046 for a true ratio 0.90 and <=0.092 for 0.85; a true ratio exactly 0.95 cannot put an upper confidence bound below 0.95 except at degenerate variance. These are sensitivity limits, not a guarantee; cluster intervals and the exact test decide.

measurement.timed_primary_justification: The frozen aimed method and rho retain named native work with no universal GAE conversion, so counted GAE alone is a lower bound and can be unrankable. Paired complete-call wall on one immutable binary and homogeneous c8a.2xlarge L2 placements captures that work for this finite host/workload claim. Exact counters and the 0/0.1/1 band remain mandatory descriptive diagnostics; they are not a complete-pricing or cross-hardware verdict.

placement.deadline_rule: The outer Job deadline covers the full ecbench session, replay-all, canonical export and immutable upload; 7800 seconds is the frozen 6600-second estimate plus 1200 seconds upload grace and must never be inferred from the 3600-second per-child cap.
placement.attempt_receipt: Every request id, Job UID, Pod name/UID, node name, instance id/type, capacity, attempt, zero restart count, exact requests/limits/node selector, digest-suffixed image, exact argv, payload bytes/SHA-256, terminal reason, durable object key/version, and verified readback bytes/SHA-256 is retained, including failed and refused attempts. Frozen requests are exact protocol-canonical bytes. The provider identity is a canonical fixed-shape semantic object; the Pod/Job projection is deterministically reconstructed from frozen image, argv, payload, placement, resources, restart policy and deadlines, and its canonical SHA-256 must equal the pre-data request anchor. Every produced core session file and every decisive replay/export/control/comparison file consumed by analysis has exactly one authenticated attempt owner.
placement.launch_rule: After one passing control-n13 session and immutable-image gate, launch both target cells concurrently; neither target may remain not_attempted, and exact-placement refusal must be an authenticated infrastructure_blocked attempt. After a non-passing control both target attempt arrays stay empty with the exact prerequisite-failure reason. Never substitute a heterogeneous node.

stopping_rules.rule: Run exactly two target sizes, eight public targets per size, five measured rounds and one warmup for every frozen arm; never stop on an effect estimate.
Do not launch either target cell unless the focused-gate receipt, frozen protocol/checkpoint, immutable image identity, n=13 LP=0/2LP positive control and its replay-all receipt all pass.

If the exact c8a.2xlarge request for four exclusive vCPUs, 8Gi memory, a 7800-second outer Job deadline and a 3600-second per-child cap cannot be admitted during preflight, classify that cell BLOCKED; do not shrink the domain, target set or accounting boundary after data.

A scientific exhaustion, cap or child timeout is retained and yields CENSORED NON-IMPROVEMENT for the affected wall claim, never INVALID and never a scientific retry. A preregistered resource refusal or authenticated infrastructure failure is BLOCKED and alone may use the frozen infrastructure retry allowance. INVALID is reserved for identity, protocol, replay, exact-equation or answer-verification violations.

invalidation_rules: Any n=53/n=61 candidate execution before this protocol is frozen and checkpoint-gated.
Source commit, binary SHA-256, image digest, Cargo.lock, flags or thread count differs between arms or from the frozen identities.
LP=0 differs from the frozen baseline in recovered value or replayed operation/counter identity.
Any projected-row or final-log verification failure, wrong answer, target mismatch, or replay-all mismatch.
Any aimed candidate emits or admits a direct two-summand base relation, or reports aimed_lp_direct_two_sum other than exactly zero.
The nonzero-LP adapter's focused ordinary aimed three-sum hit-trial census or probe scalars differ from the frozen collector on the deterministic control fixture, or any adapted witness fails replay.

Fewer than eight complete target clusters or fewer than five admitted L2 repeated pairs for a timed comparison prevents a finite-host improvement verdict; authenticated infrastructure loss is BLOCKED, scientific exhaustion/timeout is CENSORED NON-IMPROVEMENT, and lower-isolation rows remain descriptive.
A/A operation ratio differs from exactly one, or its admitted whole-call 95% interval does not contain one within [0.9,1.1].
A target or failed row is dropped, replaced or rerun for a scientific reason.
An unpriced unit named by either arm lacks a numeric count: the counted band and any ranking that needs it are UNRANKABLE, not zero.

decision_rule.text: Evaluate C-c05 and C-c1 separately at each size on complete cold solve_wall_ns. Collapse the five repeated rounds within each of the eight public targets, then compute the candidate/baseline ratio of sums, a 95% target-cluster bootstrap interval, and an exact one-sided 2^8 sign-flip test of target contrasts sum(candidate)-0.95*sum(baseline). Holm adjusts the four wall tests. A configuration is IMPROVEMENT only if all scheduled artifacts are retained, every affected answer and replay verifies, LP=0 and A/A operation gates pass, the A/A target-cluster wall interval contains one within [0.9,1.1], LP verification failures and direct-two-sum rows are zero, the adjusted p is <=0.05, and the candidate wall-ratio upper bound is <=0.95 at both sizes. The 0/0.1/1 pricing band is reported separately and becomes UNRANKABLE PRICING at a weight with an unnamed numeric unit; it never erases or upgrades the finite-host wall verdict. Scientific exhaustion/cap/timeout is CENSORED NON-IMPROVEMENT, authenticated resource/infrastructure refusal is BLOCKED, and INVALID is reserved for protocol, identity, correctness or replay violations.
decision_rule.threshold: finite-host complete-cold candidate/baseline wall upper 95% bound <= 0.95 at both sizes; counted 0/0.1/1 prices are descriptive
decision_rule.statistic: ratio of total complete cold wall over paired rows after aggregating five repeats inside each of eight public-target clusters; exact one-sided sign-flip statistic is sum over the eight target contrasts candidate-0.95*baseline
decision_rule.interval: 95% paired target-cluster percentile interval; exact enumeration of all 256 target-level sign assignments gives the one-sided p-value; Holm adjusts the four candidate wall tests
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: candidate/baseline complete cold ratio and reciprocal speedup

literature.ref: Victor Shoup, Lower Bounds for Discrete Logarithms and Related Problems, EUROCRYPT 1997, DOI 10.1007/3-540-69053-0_18
literature.claim: A generic-group algorithm has square-root-order query complexity up to the theorem's success-probability and group-order conditions. This pair-table/large-prime composition uses generic group representations and therefore makes no sub-square-root asymptotic ECDLP claim.
literature.verified_by: Primary-source metadata and theorem scope were reviewed; repository citation inventory is recorded in RESEARCH_PRIME_FIELD_BREAKTHROUGH_PROGRAM.md and docs/session-logs/2026-10-31.md.

literature.ref: Pierrick Gaudry, Emmanuel Thomé and Nicolas Thériault, A double large prime variation for small genus hyperelliptic index calculus, February 2005, sections 2.3 and 3.1, https://cacr.uwaterloo.ca/techreports/2004/corr2004-29.pdf
literature.claim: The paper motivates coefficient-aware large-prime graph elimination and distinguishes cycles yielding full relations from cycles that retain a large prime. Its complexity result assumes genus at least three and its stated relation model; neither the genus nor the complexity theorem transfers here.

literature.ref: Claus Diem, On the discrete logarithm problem in class groups of curves, Mathematics of Computation 80 (2011), https://www.ams.org/journals/mcom/2011-80-273/S0025-5718-2010-02281-1/home.html
literature.claim: Large-prime graph arguments in curve class groups depend on that curve/class-group relation model. They establish precedent for elimination, not a complexity transfer to this Koblitz elliptic-curve decomposition.

For the repository single-large-prime residual collector, bounding the residual domain lowers entry and collision rates together. At n=23 and 2, 3 and 5 columns, the residual collector cost 1.9--4x the direct-table relation phase even at the full-group residual limit.
literature.verified_by: The named methodology section records the break-even analysis, observed range and falsifier. This residual-yield floor is an explicit assumption/adverse prior, not silently discarded.

literature.verified_by: Remote protocol, results, band files, replay certificate and VALIDATION.json inspected before this protocol.

method_governance.classification: generic pair-table decomposition plus exact double-large-prime graph elimination
method_governance.counting_model: For a fixed target and aimed third-summand window, candidate sums are treated as approximately uniform and independent in the prime-order subgroup. Base and large-prime signed orbits are exact and disjoint; only residual-free, independently verified projected equations contribute rank. Duplicate/orbit correlation, sparse-rank loss, domain-scan cost and graph closure are measured rather than idealised away.
assumptions: correct signed-Frobenius canonicalisation and cofactor-projected column mapping
bounded disjoint residual domain with no direct two-summand Base emission
focused ordinary aimed three-sum opportunity and probe-scalar parity with the frozen collector
independent exact row verification before sparse-rank ingestion
eight public target contrasts are independent and sign-exchangeable for the exact sign-flip test
the repository residual-yield floor remains an applicable adverse prior
method_governance.non_transfer: Hyperelliptic-genus and curve-class-group large-prime theorems motivate the graph mechanism but do not transfer an exponent or complexity claim to this elliptic-curve workload.
